scope: Central Texas corridor (McLennan, Bell, Coryell, Brazos counties) - basic needs

records.name: Find Food Now (Central Texas Food Bank, incl. former Shepherd's Heart Waco)
records.description_en: Free groceries through local pantries, mobile food pantries, and programs for kids and seniors. Enter your ZIP code on the Find Food Now tool to see nearby places, days, and times.
records.description_es: Comida gratis en despensas cercanas, despensas móviles y programas para niños y personas mayores. Escriba su código postal en la herramienta Find Food Now para ver lugares, días y horarios cerca de usted.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to people who need food in the food bank's service area, including Waco and Killeen.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Para personas que necesitan comida en el área del banco de comida, incluyendo Waco y Killeen.
records.how_to_apply: Use the Find Food Now tool on the website and enter your ZIP code, or call the food bank. You can also dial 2-1-1.
records.how_to_apply_es: Use la herramienta Find Food Now en el sitio web y escriba su código postal, o llame al banco de comida. También puede marcar 2-1-1.
records.notes: Shepherd's Heart (Waco) merger confirmed at https://www.centraltexasfoodbank.org/shepherds-heart. Main office: 6500 Metropolis Drive, Austin 78744. SNAP/benefits application help: (855) 366-3401. 2-1-1 multilingual help 24/7: (877) 541-7905. The pages read did not list counties served; McLennan (Waco) is supported by the Shepherd's Heart merger page, Bell (Killeen) only by photos of Killeen distributions. Check Find Food Now by ZIP to confirm nearby sites.

records.name: Brazos Valley Food Bank - Find Food
records.description_en: Regional food bank that supplies local food pantries and runs a mobile food pantry, senior outreach, school pantries, a children's BackPack program, and home delivery (Project GotEM).
records.description_es: Banco de comida regional que surte a despensas locales. También tiene despensa móvil, ayuda para personas mayores, despensas en escuelas, el programa de mochilas para niños (BackPack) y entrega a domicilio (Project GotEM).
records.eligibility_summary_en: People who need food in the Brazos Valley. Each partner pantry may have its own rules.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas que necesitan comida en el Valle de Brazos. Cada despensa puede tener sus propias reglas.
records.how_to_apply: Use the pantry list (English and Spanish) or interactive pantry map on the Find Food page, or call the food bank. Dial 2-1-1 for more help.
records.how_to_apply_es: Use la lista de despensas (en inglés y español) o el mapa en la página Find Food, o llame al banco de comida. Marque 2-1-1 para más ayuda.
records.notes: Phone and address confirmed on https://www.bvfb.org/contact-us. Pantry list is available in English and Spanish. Food bank also offers community resources and benefits assistance and employment assistance.

records.name: Neighborhood Food Pantry and Financial Assistance
records.description_en: Free food pantry plus crisis help with rent and utility bills.
records.description_es: Despensa de comida gratis y ayuda en momentos de crisis para pagar la renta y los recibos de servicios.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Neighbors in need in the Belton area. Eligibility details are not posted; call to ask.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Vecinos con necesidad en el área de Belton. Las reglas no están publicadas; llame para preguntar.
records.how_to_apply: Visit during open hours or call to ask about the food pantry and financial help.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya durante el horario de atención o llame para preguntar por la despensa y la ayuda con pagos.
records.hours: Mon 12 pm-6 pm; Wed 10 am-4 pm; Thu 10 am-4 pm
records.notes: Email info@helpinghandsbelton.org. Also runs Project Apple Tree (holiday help).

records.name: Salvation Army Waco - Shelter, Meals, Pantry and Emergency Assistance
records.description_en: Free daily meals at the Community Kitchen, shelters for men and for women and families, a food pantry with groceries and baby items, and help with rent and utility bills.
records.description_es: Comidas gratis todos los días en la Cocina Comunitaria, albergues para hombres y para mujeres con familias, una despensa con comida y artículos para bebé, y ayuda para pagar la renta y los servicios.
records.eligibility_summary_en: People in need in Waco, including people who are homeless.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas con necesidad en Waco, incluyendo personas sin hogar.
records.how_to_apply: Call Social Services or visit the office at 4721 W Waco Dr. The food pantry there is open Monday to Thursday.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a Servicios Sociales o vaya a la oficina en 4721 W Waco Dr. La despensa de comida ahí abre de lunes a jueves.
records.notes: Other sites: Community Kitchen & Men's Shelter, 300 Webster Ave, Waco 76706; Sally's House (women & families with children), 524 S 4th St, Waco 76706; Corps center, 1225 South I-35 Frontage Rd, Waco 76706. Also offers veteran services and addiction support.

records.name: Mission Waco Services (Meyer Center, Creekside Community Village, Clothesline)
records.description_en: Faith-based nonprofit with social services at the Meyer Center, permanent supportive housing at Creekside Community Village, a recovery program, and a clothing voucher center.
records.description_es: Organización de fe con servicios sociales en el Meyer Center, vivienda permanente con apoyo en Creekside Community Village, un programa de recuperación y un centro de ropa con vales.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Low-income and homeless people in Waco. Call for program-specific rules.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas de bajos ingresos y personas sin hogar en Waco. Llame para saber las reglas de cada programa.
records.how_to_apply: Call the main number to ask which program fits your need.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al número principal para preguntar qué programa le sirve.
records.notes: Program addresses and hours were not listed on the homepage; call the main number.

records.name: Doug Weedon Shelter for Hope
records.description_en: Emergency shelter for men, women, and families who are homeless, with free meals, laundry and hygiene supplies, and case management to plan for permanent housing. Free meals at the Community Cafe Monday-Friday at noon and 5 pm.
records.description_es: Albergue de emergencia para hombres, mujeres y familias sin hogar, con comidas gratis, artículos de lavandería e higiene, y un trabajador social que le ayuda a planear una vivienda permanente. Comidas gratis en el Community Cafe de lunes a viernes a las 12 del mediodía y a las 5 pm.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Any man, woman, or family who is homeless.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Cualquier hombre, mujer o familia sin hogar.
records.how_to_apply: Call the shelter or go to the shelter address.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al albergue o vaya a la dirección del albergue.
records.hours: Community Cafe meals Mon-Fri at 12 pm and 5 pm
records.notes: Email homelessservices@twincitymission.org. Main Twin City Mission office (2505 South College Avenue, Bryan 77801, (979) 822-7511) was not re-confirmed on the page read.

records.name: Families In Crisis - Shelter, Hotline and Housing Help
records.description_en: Emergency shelter, crisis counseling, and housing help for survivors of family violence and sexual assault and for people without housing. Runs the Friends In Crisis homeless shelter and rental assistance in Killeen and Temple.
records.description_es: Albergue de emergencia, consejería en crisis y ayuda con vivienda para sobrevivientes de violencia familiar o agresión sexual, y para personas sin hogar. También tiene el albergue Friends In Crisis para personas sin vivienda y ayuda con la renta en Killeen y Temple.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Survivors of family violence or sexual assault and people who are homeless in Bell, Coryell, and Hamilton counties. You do not need money, papers, or a police report.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Sobrevivientes de violencia familiar o agresión sexual, y personas sin hogar, en los condados de Bell, Coryell y Hamilton. No necesita dinero, papeles ni reporte de policía.
records.how_to_apply: Call the 24-hour hotline, text (254) 634-1184, or walk in to the Killeen office Monday-Friday 8 am-5 pm. No appointment needed.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de ayuda de 24 horas, mande un mensaje de texto al (254) 634-1184, o vaya sin cita a la oficina de Killeen de lunes a viernes de 8 am a 5 pm.
records.notes: Outreach offices in Killeen, Temple, Gatesville, and Hamilton. Emergency shelters in Killeen and Temple (addresses confidential). Other listed phones: (254) 773-7765, (254) 970-2480. Also runs Supportive Services for Veteran Families (rental help for low-income veteran households). Site's security certificate was expired when checked on 2026-09-26; content was read directly and matched this record.

records.name: Family Abuse Center
records.description_en: Emergency shelter for domestic violence survivors and their children, plus counseling, case management, legal help, housing help, and transportation help.
records.description_es: Albergue de emergencia para sobrevivientes de violencia doméstica y sus hijos, además de consejería, apoyo de un trabajador social, ayuda legal, ayuda con vivienda y ayuda con transporte.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Victims of domestic violence in Waco and nearby rural counties.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Víctimas de violencia doméstica en Waco y condados rurales cercanos.
records.how_to_apply: Call the 24-hour hotline. For emergencies, call 911.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea de ayuda de 24 horas. En una emergencia, llame al 911.
records.notes: Shelter address is confidential. Email info@familyabusecenter.org.

records.name: Public Housing and Housing Choice Vouchers (Section 8)
records.description_en: Low-cost public housing in Waco and Mart and Housing Choice Vouchers (Section 8) that help pay rent. Also offers family self-sufficiency, homeownership, and housing stabilization programs.
records.description_es: Vivienda pública de bajo costo en Waco y Mart, y vales de vivienda (Sección 8) que ayudan a pagar la renta. También tiene programas para ser más independiente, comprar casa y mantener su vivienda.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Low-income residents of Waco and McLennan County. Waiting lists open at certain times.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas de bajos ingresos en Waco y el condado McLennan. Las listas de espera se abren solo en ciertas fechas.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online through the housing authority's applicant portal, or call the office.
records.how_to_apply_es: Presente su solicitud en línea en el portal de la autoridad de vivienda, o llame a la oficina.
records.notes: TTY: (800) 545-1833. Office hours not posted. Site announced the Melody Grove Apartments waiting list opening May 11, 2026 for 1- and 2-bedroom units; check the site for current waitlist status. Also runs Freedom's Path Waco (veterans).

records.name: Housing Choice Voucher Program
records.description_en: Section 8 vouchers that pay part of your rent directly to the landlord so you can choose your own home.
records.description_es: Vales de la Sección 8 que pagan parte de su renta directamente al dueño, para que usted pueda escoger su casa.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Very low-income families, older adults, and people with disabilities. Income generally may not be over 50% of the area median income. Must be a U.S. citizen or eligible non-citizen.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Familias de muy bajos ingresos, personas mayores y personas con discapacidad. Por lo general, el ingreso no puede pasar del 50% del ingreso medio del área. Debe ser ciudadano de EE. UU. o inmigrante elegible.
records.how_to_apply: The waiting list is closed. Check the BVCOG page or call to find out when it reopens; existing applicants can update information in the applicant portal.
records.how_to_apply_es: La lista de espera está cerrada. Revise la página de BVCOG o llame para saber cuándo vuelve a abrir. Si ya aplicó, puede actualizar sus datos en el portal.
records.notes: Waiting list closed as of May 31, 2024 per the page (still shown as closed on 2026-09-26). Operator: (979) 595-2800. Also serves Burleson, Grimes (not Navasota), Leon, Madison, Robertson, Washington (not Brenham).

records.name: Section 8 Housing Assistance Program
records.description_en: Housing vouchers that help low-income families, older adults, and people with disabilities pay rent.
records.description_es: Vales de vivienda que ayudan a familias de bajos ingresos, personas mayores y personas con discapacidad a pagar la renta.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Low-income families, the elderly, and people with disabilities in the CTCOG region. Income limits are in the program's posted income limit document.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Familias de bajos ingresos, personas mayores y personas con discapacidad en la región de CTCOG. Los límites de ingreso están en el documento que publica el programa.
records.how_to_apply: Fill out a pre-application to join the waiting list when it is open. You will get an appointment letter by mail.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llene una pre-solicitud para entrar a la lista de espera cuando esté abierta. Le llegará por correo una carta con su cita.
records.hours: Mon-Fri 8 am-5 pm (case manager meetings by appointment only)
records.notes: Waiting list was CLOSED when checked on 2026-09-26 ('check back after the first of the year'). Check your place on the list at waitlistcheck.com; email intake@ctcog.org to update your contact info. Counties served are not listed on the page; Coryell coverage not confirmed.

records.name: Comprehensive Energy Assistance Program (CEAP)
records.organization: Hill Country Community Action Association, Inc.
records.description_en: Helps low-income households pay electric and gas bills. HCCAA also offers weatherization to make homes more energy efficient.
records.description_es: Ayuda a familias de bajos ingresos a pagar los recibos de luz y gas. HCCAA también ofrece mejoras a la casa para que gaste menos energía.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Low-income households in HCCAA's service area, which includes Bell and Coryell counties.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Familias de bajos ingresos en el área que atiende HCCAA, que incluye los condados de Bell y Coryell.
records.how_to_apply: Call HCCAA's toll-free number to ask about applying, or visit the Killeen or Temple Help Center.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame gratis a HCCAA para preguntar cómo aplicar, o visite el Centro de Ayuda en Killeen o en Temple.
records.notes: Main office is in San Saba (2905 West Wallace St., 76877). Help centers are in Killeen and Temple; their street addresses were not listed on the pages read. Email hccaainc@hccaa.com. Counties confirmed on https://www.hccaa.com/about.

records.name: Case Management (CSBG) Self-Sufficiency Program
records.organization: Hill Country Community Action Association, Inc.
records.description_en: A case manager helps you set goals toward self-sufficiency and may help pay for utility bills, transportation, education, job search costs, and food.
records.description_es: Un trabajador social le ayuda a ponerse metas para salir adelante por su cuenta, y puede ayudarle a pagar servicios, transporte, estudios, gastos para buscar trabajo y comida.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Households that meet income limits and pass a pre-screening showing they are ready to commit to the program.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Familias que cumplen con los límites de ingreso y pasan una evaluación que muestra que están listas para comprometerse con el programa.
records.how_to_apply: Call HCCAA or email to ask for a pre-screening.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o mande un correo a HCCAA para pedir una evaluación.
records.notes: Help centers in Killeen and Temple. Exact income limit not posted.

records.name: Utility Assistance (CEAP) and Weatherization
records.organization: Brazos Valley Community Action Programs (BVCAP), a program of Brazos Valley Council of Governments
records.description_en: Helps low-income households pay utility bills and offers weatherization. BVCAP also offers case management, affordable rental housing, Head Start, and Meals on Wheels.
records.description_es: Ayuda a familias de bajos ingresos a pagar los recibos de servicios y ofrece mejoras a la casa para ahorrar energía. BVCAP también tiene apoyo de trabajadores sociales, renta a precio accesible, Head Start y Meals on Wheels.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Low-income households in the Brazos Valley. Eligibility is based on income guidelines.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Familias de bajos ingresos en el Valle de Brazos. Se decide según las guías de ingreso.
records.how_to_apply: Call or email BVCAP, or visit the main office.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o mande un correo a BVCAP, o vaya a la oficina principal.
records.notes: Email bvcapcontact@bvcog.org. The former Brazos Valley Community Action Agency (BVCAA) site says its services moved to HealthPoint (clinics) and Community Action (Head Start, Meals on Wheels, WIC).

records.name: Waco Transit Reduced Fares
records.description_en: City bus rides for $0.50 for seniors, people with disabilities, and Medicare card holders (regular fare $1.50). Children 5 and under ride free, and Waco ISD, MCC, TSTC, and Baylor students ride free with student ID.
records.description_es: Viajes en autobús de la ciudad por $0.50 para personas mayores, personas con discapacidad y personas con tarjeta de Medicare (la tarifa normal es $1.50). Los niños de 5 años o menos viajan gratis, y los estudiantes de Waco ISD, MCC, TSTC y Baylor viajan gratis con su credencial.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Seniors and Medicare card holders need a Waco Transit ID. Riders with disabilities must apply and be approved. Students at Waco ISD, MCC, TSTC, and Baylor ride free with school ID.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Las personas mayores y con Medicare necesitan una credencial de Waco Transit. Las personas con discapacidad deben aplicar y ser aprobadas. Los estudiantes de Waco ISD, MCC, TSTC y Baylor viajan gratis con su credencial escolar.
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit Waco Transit to get a reduced-fare ID or apply for the disability fare.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o vaya a Waco Transit para sacar su credencial de tarifa reducida o aplicar a la tarifa por discapacidad.
records.cost: $0.50 reduced fare; Reduced Fare Day Pass $1.25
records.notes: Fixed route info: (254) 750-1613. Administration: (254) 750-1900. Pay on the bus with cash only. Students at other schools pay $1.00 per ride with a Waco Transit Student ID.

records.name: Waco Transit Demand Response (ADA Paratransit)
records.description_en: Door-to-door rides for people who cannot use the regular bus, including rides to medical appointments.
records.description_es: Viajes de puerta a puerta para personas que no pueden usar el autobús normal, incluyendo viajes a citas médicas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Riders who qualify for ADA paratransit service. Personal care attendants ride free.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas que califican para el servicio de transporte ADA. Su asistente personal viaja gratis.
records.how_to_apply: Call Demand Response to apply and schedule trips.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a Demand Response para aplicar y programar sus viajes.

records.name: The HOP (Hill Country Transit District)
records.description_en: Public transit in Bell, Coryell, and Milam counties, including microtransit, commuter service, the Cavazos Connector, and rural demand-response rides.
records.description_es: Transporte público en los condados de Bell, Coryell y Milam, con viajes por pedido (microtransit), servicio para quienes viajan al trabajo, el Cavazos Connector y viajes por pedido en zonas rurales.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to the public. Accessible service for people with disabilities.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto a todo el público. Servicio accesible para personas con discapacidad.
records.how_to_apply: Book a ride with the mobile app, online, or by calling an agent.
records.how_to_apply_es: Pida su viaje con la aplicación móvil, en línea o llamando a un agente.
records.cost: Fare varies; see Fare Media Pricing on the website
records.notes: Also serves Milam County. Language assistance available for people with limited English (Spanish and other languages). Reduced fare and ADA details are on separate pages not checked.

records.name: Brazos Transit District (fixed routes, ADA paratransit, demand response)
records.description_en: Bus routes, ADA paratransit, and demand-response rides across 20 counties including the Bryan-College Station area. Senior and disabled passes are available.
records.description_es: Rutas de autobús, transporte ADA y viajes por pedido en 20 condados, incluyendo el área de Bryan-College Station. Hay pases para personas mayores y con discapacidad.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to the public. Seniors and people with disabilities can apply for reduced-fare passes.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto a todo el público. Las personas mayores y con discapacidad pueden pedir un pase de tarifa reducida.
records.how_to_apply: Call the dispatch center to book demand-response or paratransit rides; apply for a senior or disabled pass.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al centro de despacho para pedir viajes por pedido o transporte ADA. Pida su pase para persona mayor o con discapacidad.
records.cost: Fare varies; senior and disabled passes available
records.notes: Toll-free: (800) 272-0039 (also for info in another language, large print, or braille). Customer service: (979) 778-0607 ext 7008. Existing riders can book at https://portal.btd.org; new riders call Dispatch to set up an account.

records.name: Workforce Solutions for the Heart of Texas - Waco Center
records.organization: Workforce Solutions for the Heart of Texas
records.description_en: Free job search help, training, GED and ESL classes, apprenticeships, veteran services, and child care assistance.
records.description_es: Ayuda gratis para buscar trabajo, capacitación, clases de GED y de inglés, aprendizajes de oficio, servicios para veteranos y ayuda con el cuidado de niños.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Job seekers and employers in Bosque, Falls, Freestone, Hill, Limestone, and McLennan counties.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas que buscan trabajo y empleadores en los condados de Bosque, Falls, Freestone, Hill, Limestone y McLennan.
records.how_to_apply: Visit the Waco workforce center or call.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya al centro de empleo de Waco o llame.
records.notes: Email questions@hotworkforce.com. Center hours were not listed on the page read.

records.name: Child Care Services (subsidized child care)
records.organization: Workforce Solutions for the Heart of Texas
records.description_en: Helps eligible parents pay for child care while they work or go to school.
records.description_es: Ayuda a padres que califican a pagar el cuidado de sus hijos mientras trabajan o estudian.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Parents in the Heart of Texas workforce area who meet TWC child care rules. Income limits were not listed on the page.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Padres en el área de Heart of Texas que cumplen las reglas de cuidado infantil de TWC. La página no dice los límites de ingreso.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online through the TWC Texas Child Care Connection (TX3C) portal, or call Child Care Services.
records.how_to_apply_es: Aplique en línea en el portal TX3C (Texas Child Care Connection) de TWC, o llame a Child Care Services.
records.cost: Parent share of cost may apply
records.notes: Toll-free (800) 772-2269; TX3C application support 1-888-265-6461. Application status questions: ccswaitlist@hotworkforce.com.

records.name: Workforce Solutions of Central Texas - Killeen and Temple Centers
records.organization: Workforce Solutions of Central Texas (Central Texas Council of Governments)
records.description_en: Free job search help, training, and workforce services at local centers.
records.description_es: Ayuda gratis para buscar trabajo, capacitación y otros servicios de empleo en centros locales.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Job seekers and employers in Central Texas.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas que buscan trabajo y empleadores en el Centro de Texas.
records.how_to_apply: Visit or call the Killeen or Temple workforce center.
records.how_to_apply_es: Vaya o llame al centro de empleo de Killeen o de Temple.
records.hours: Killeen: Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 8:30 am-5 pm; Wed 8:30 am-4 pm
records.notes: Temple center: 201 Santa Fe Way, Temple 76502, (254) 742-4400 (Mon, Tue, Wed, Fri 8:30 am-5 pm; Thu 8:30 am-4 pm). No Coryell County (Gatesville/Copperas Cove) office listed on the site.

records.name: Workforce Solutions Brazos Valley
records.description_en: Job seeker help, adult education and literacy, apprenticeships, veteran services, SNAP Employment & Training, and a Child Care & Early Learning division.
records.description_es: Ayuda para buscar trabajo, educación y alfabetización para adultos, aprendizajes de oficio, servicios para veteranos, capacitación de empleo para personas con SNAP y una división de cuidado infantil.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Job seekers and employers in the Brazos Valley.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas que buscan trabajo y empleadores en el Valle de Brazos.
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit the Bryan office.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o vaya a la oficina de Bryan.
records.notes: Operator toll-free (800) 386-7200. Part of the American Job Center network. Hours not listed.

records.name: WIC Nutrition Program - Brazos County Clinics
records.description_en: Healthy foods, nutrition education, and breastfeeding support for pregnant women, new moms, babies, and young children.
records.description_es: Comida saludable, clases de nutrición y apoyo para dar pecho, para mujeres embarazadas, mamás nuevas, bebés y niños pequeños.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Pregnant women, women breastfeeding a baby under 1, and children under 5, with household income at or below 185% of the federal poverty level and a nutrition need found at the WIC clinic.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Mujeres embarazadas, mujeres que dan pecho a un bebé menor de 1 año y niños menores de 5 años, con ingreso familiar igual o menor al 185% del nivel federal de pobreza y una necesidad de nutrición que se revisa en la clínica de WIC.
documents_needed: Proof of income for each household member with income (pay stub showing gross income, tax records, employer letter, or Social Security/support statements)
Proof of address (rent receipt or utility bill; no PO boxes)
ID for each applicant (driver's license, Social Security card, birth certificate, or school/work ID)
records.how_to_apply: Call a clinic to make an appointment. Each woman, infant, and child applying must come in person.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a una clínica para hacer una cita. Cada mujer, bebé y niño que aplica debe ir en persona.
records.notes: Other clinics: 29th Street WIC, 4001 E. 29th St, Unit #112, Bryan 77801, (979) 255-9872; College Station, 1103 Anderson St, Ste #102, College Station 77840, (979) 255-3804.

records.name: WIC - Bell County Public Health District
records.description_en: WIC nutrition services and other public health clinic services.
records.description_es: Servicios de nutrición de WIC y otros servicios de la clínica de salud pública.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Pregnant women, new mothers, infants, and young children who meet WIC rules.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Mujeres embarazadas, mamás nuevas, bebés y niños pequeños que cumplen las reglas de WIC.
records.how_to_apply: Call the health district to confirm current WIC clinic locations and hours.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al distrito de salud para confirmar dónde y a qué hora se ofrece WIC ahora.
records.notes: Copperas Cove WIC clinic permanently closed (notice 08/22/2025). The site still shows a temporary closure notice for the Temple WIC clinic dated 06/10/2025 - call before visiting to confirm where WIC is offered.

records.name: Heart of Texas Behavioral Health Network (Local Mental Health Authority)
records.organization: Heart of Texas Behavioral Health Network
records.description_en: Mental health, substance use, intellectual and developmental disability, and early childhood intervention services, with crisis help 24 hours a day.
records.description_es: Servicios de salud mental, uso de sustancias, discapacidad intelectual y del desarrollo, e intervención temprana para niños pequeños, con ayuda en crisis las 24 horas.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Residents of Bosque, Falls, Freestone, Hill, Limestone, and McLennan counties.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas que viven en los condados de Bosque, Falls, Freestone, Hill, Limestone y McLennan.
records.how_to_apply: Call the main number for services. In a crisis call the 24-hour crisis line or 988.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al número principal para pedir servicios. En una crisis, llame a la línea de crisis de 24 horas o al 988.
records.notes: 24-hour crisis line: (866) 752-3451. Also offers veterans services.

records.name: Central Counties Services (Local Mental Health Authority)
records.description_en: Mental health screening and treatment, youth programs, early childhood intervention, and services for intellectual and developmental disabilities, with a 24/7 crisis line.
records.description_es: Evaluación y tratamiento de salud mental, programas para jóvenes, intervención temprana para niños pequeños y servicios para discapacidad intelectual y del desarrollo, con línea de crisis 24/7.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Residents of the Central Counties Services area.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas que viven en el área que atiende Central Counties Services.
records.how_to_apply: Call the non-crisis line for intake, or the crisis hotline any time.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la línea que no es de crisis para empezar, o a la línea de crisis a cualquier hora.
records.notes: Crisis hotline: (800) 888-4036; non-crisis toll-free: (844) 815-6221 (press 1 for mental health screening and intake). Counties served were not listed on the homepage; Coryell coverage not confirmed.

records.name: MHMR Authority of Brazos Valley (Local Mental Health Authority)
records.description_en: Services for mental illness, substance use, and intellectual and developmental disabilities, with a 24/7 crisis hotline.
records.description_es: Servicios para enfermedades mentales, uso de sustancias y discapacidad intelectual y del desarrollo, con línea de crisis 24/7.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Children and adults in the seven-county Brazos Valley area.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Niños y adultos en el área de siete condados del Valle de Brazos.
records.how_to_apply: Call the main number. For a mental health or substance use crisis call the 24/7 hotline.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame al número principal. En una crisis de salud mental o de uso de sustancias, llame a la línea de crisis 24/7.
records.notes: 24/7 crisis hotline: (888) 522-8262. Toll-free: (800) 282-6467. Routine mental health services: (979) 361-9815. Crisis Triage & Diversion Center: 1906 South College Avenue, Bryan 77801, Mon-Fri 8 am-11 pm, (979) 361-9891. Mailing: P.O. Box 4588, Bryan, TX 77805.

records.name: HealthPoint Community Health Centers (FQHC)
records.description_en: Federally qualified health center with medical, dental, behavioral health, and pharmacy services.
records.description_es: Centro de salud comunitario (FQHC) con servicios médicos, dentales, de salud mental y farmacia.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Open to families in the Brazos Valley. Accepts most insurance, including Medicare, Medicaid, and CHIP. If you have no insurance, the eligibility team can help you apply for assistance.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Abierto a las familias del Valle de Brazos. Acepta la mayoría de los seguros, incluyendo Medicare, Medicaid y CHIP. Si no tiene seguro, el equipo de elegibilidad le puede ayudar a pedir asistencia.
records.how_to_apply: New patients must call to make an appointment. The Bryan-College Station clinic offers same-day care.
records.how_to_apply_es: Los pacientes nuevos deben llamar para hacer una cita. La clínica de Bryan-College Station atiende el mismo día.
records.cost: Accepts most insurance; help for uninsured patients
records.notes: FQHC status confirmed on https://healthpoint-tx.com/ (Health Center Program grantee). Bryan - Memorial Clinic: 1301 Memorial Drive, Bryan 77802, (979) 731-4520 (pediatrics, maternal care, women's health, behavioral health, dental). Sliding fee amounts not confirmed.

records.name: Free Civil Legal Aid (Waco, Belton, Bryan offices)
records.description_en: Free civil legal help, such as housing and eviction problems, for people with low income.
records.description_es: Ayuda legal civil gratis, por ejemplo con problemas de vivienda y desalojo, para personas de bajos ingresos.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Clients must meet financial and legal status eligibility rules.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Las personas deben cumplir las reglas de ingreso y de estatus legal.
records.how_to_apply: Apply online any time using the intake form, or call the toll-free number.
records.how_to_apply_es: Aplique en línea a cualquier hora con el formulario, o llame al número gratuito.
records.notes: Waco office serves McLennan (and Bosque, Falls, Freestone, Hill, Limestone, Navarro); Belton office serves Bell and Coryell (and Hamilton, Lampasas, Milam); Bryan office serves Brazos (and Burleson, Grimes, Lee, Leon, Madison, Robertson). Local office addresses were not listed on the page read. Each office has set times for non-emergency phone applications.

records.name: Area Agency on Aging of the Heart of Texas
records.organization: Heart of Texas Council of Governments
records.description_en: Benefits counseling, caregiver support, care coordination, and access to senior meals and home repairs through partner senior centers.
records.description_es: Consejería sobre beneficios, apoyo para cuidadores, coordinación de cuidados, y acceso a comidas y reparaciones de casa para personas mayores por medio de centros comunitarios.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Adults age 60 and older (some exceptions). Medicare recipients of any age can get benefits counseling.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Adultos de 60 años o más (con algunas excepciones). Las personas con Medicare de cualquier edad pueden recibir consejería sobre beneficios.
records.how_to_apply: Call the Area Agency on Aging.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la Agencia del Área para Personas Mayores.
records.notes: Serves Bosque, Falls, Freestone, Hill, Limestone and McLennan counties.

records.name: Area Agency on Aging of Central Texas
records.description_en: Nutrition and home and community-based services to help older adults stay in their homes.
records.description_es: Servicios de nutrición y servicios en casa y en la comunidad para ayudar a las personas mayores a seguir viviendo en su hogar.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Persons 60 years of age or older.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Personas de 60 años o más.
records.how_to_apply: Call the agency.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame a la agencia.
records.notes: Toll-free: (855) 937-2372. Counties served not listed on the page read; Coryell coverage not confirmed.

records.name: Homebuyer and Home Repair Assistance
records.organization: City of Bryan Community Development Department
records.description_en: Programs for homebuyer help, major home rehabilitation, minor repairs, foundation repair, and voluntary demolition.
records.description_es: Programas de ayuda para comprar casa, reparaciones grandes, reparaciones pequeñas, reparación de cimientos y demolición voluntaria.
records.eligibility_summary_en: Bryan residents who meet each program's rules.
records.eligibility_summary_es: Residentes de Bryan que cumplen las reglas de cada programa.
records.how_to_apply: Call or visit the Development Center to get application forms.
records.how_to_apply_es: Llame o vaya al Development Center para pedir los formularios.
